Dear @everyone,

Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts for your help! We have compiled the translation contributions we've received so far; the translations will go live after the upcoming V2.5.3 update (07/23/2026)

The list of Volunteers in our in-game Special Thanks page will also be updated according to this list. Please confirm if we have logged your name (the name you want us to credit you by) and contribution content correctly! If there is any mistake, please let me know and we will fix it asap.

⭐ Translation & Proofreading ⭐

JP: 
● Alza — Proofreading & Translation (Astral Reign Chapter 2, and more)

EN: 
● Anicillia — Translation & Voiceline (Various Awakeners Translated and Voiceline)

KR: 
● 성우학과대학생의현실살이, Lasha, FongDue, ASTAR, 량, Ploara.V.C, Hierarch, Lica, 때까치, KD, 별이, 외곽, Francis, SJ88, Cullet, Bahisa, Yeon — Optimization (Skill and combat gameplay-related terminology)

If we've missed anyone or logged anything incorrectly, just let us know and we'll fix it right away. Thank you all again! 💙
I keep forgetting to submit all the things that were done through my repo <:karen_nervous:1408324291237511259> I'll do that tomorrow. Please do make sure they get into the next update if possible!
